parameters.content:
## GALLARDO — School Mail Historical Import
One-off / on-demand backfill: every message currently in the Gmail inbox from the allowed school senders is analysed with the same nodes as School Mail Intelligence and written to the same `school_mail` tab.

**Triggers:** manual run, or called by School Mail Assistant (Execute Workflow). Returns one summary item. No Telegram.
**Setup:** fill in **Config** (`allowed_senders`, `sheet_id`), attach the 3 credentials.
See `workflows/school-mail-historical-import/README.md`.

nodes.name: Manual Run
nodes.notes: Controlled test run from the editor.

nodes.name: When Called by Assistant
nodes.notes: Entry point for School Mail Assistant (Execute Workflow node). Input data is ignored; the result is the last node output (one summary item).

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Same settings as School Mail Intelligence (keep them in sync). allowed_senders: the two school senders, comma-separated (exact address or @domain). It also builds the Gmail search. Execute Once: a caller sending several items still runs one import.

nodes.name: Build Query
nodes.notes: Gmail search built from Config.allowed_senders: in:inbox {from:A from:B} ({} means OR). @domain entries become from:domain.

nodes.name: Senders Configured?
nodes.notes: false: allowed_senders still has placeholders. Nothing is read from Gmail.

assignments.name: error_message
assignments.value: Config.allowed_senders is not configured (placeholder values). Nothing was imported.

nodes.name: Config Error Result
nodes.notes: Returned to the caller when the senders are not set.

nodes.name: List Inbox Messages
nodes.notes: Return All (follows nextPageToken, no maxResults cap). Read and unread. Metadata only: bodies and attachments are downloaded later, and only for messages that still need analysis. Errors continue as an {error} item so the summary can report them.

nodes.name: Read Existing Rows
nodes.notes: One read of the whole school_mail tab for the import (instead of one lookup per message, which would hit the Sheets per-minute read quota). Errors continue as an {error} item.

nodes.name: Classify Messages
nodes.notes: One item per message to analyse (new or llm_failed). If none, or Gmail/Sheets failed, a single item with run info only.

nodes.name: Has Pending?
nodes.notes: false: nothing to analyse, or an infrastructure error. Straight to the summary.

nodes.name: Loop Over Emails
nodes.notes: Sequential, one email per iteration: attachments of different emails are never mixed and OpenRouter, Gmail and Sheets see one request at a time. Done collects one outcome item per email.

nodes.name: Current Message
nodes.notes: Message of this iteration. Later nodes read it with $('Current Message').first().

nodes.name: Get Message
nodes.notes: Full message with body, HTML and attachments: the same shape as the Gmail Trigger output (Simplify off, attachment_ prefix), so the copied nodes work unchanged.

nodes.name: Is School Sender?
nodes.notes: Same authoritative allowlist check as School Mail Intelligence (the Gmail from: search is broader, e.g. subdomains). false: recorded and skipped.

nodes.name: Record Not Allowed
nodes.notes: Sender not in allowed_senders. No row written.

nodes.name: Record Fetch Failure
nodes.notes: The message could not be downloaded. Recorded; the import continues.

nodes.name: Normalize Email
nodes.notes: Clean email fields. Uses the plain-text body, or the HTML body with tags stripped when there is no plain text. Keeps the attachment binaries for later.

nodes.name: Has Attachments?
nodes.notes: No attachments: go straight to the LLM input.

nodes.name: Split Attachments
nodes.notes: One item per attachment with its route (pdf, docx, image, other). Small images (logos, signatures) and images beyond the limit are marked as skipped.

nodes.name: Route by Type
nodes.notes: Outputs: 0 PDF, 1 DOCX, 2 image, 3 unsupported or skipped.

nodes.name: Extract PDF Text
nodes.notes: Text layer only. Scanned PDFs return no text (no OCR in v1).

nodes.name: PDF Result
nodes.notes: Empty text means the PDF is probably scanned: status no_text.

nodes.name: PDF Failed
nodes.notes: The attachment could not be read. Recorded and processing continues.

nodes.name: Unzip DOCX
nodes.notes: A DOCX file is a ZIP archive. Its text lives in word/document.xml.

nodes.name: Read DOCX Text
nodes.notes: Extracts paragraphs from word/document.xml. Never throws; failures become status failed.

nodes.name: DOCX Failed
nodes.notes: The attachment could not be read. Recorded and processing continues.

nodes.name: Read Image
nodes.notes: Base64-encodes the image so it can be sent to the vision model.

nodes.name: Image Result
nodes.notes: Image is passed to the LLM as an image_url part.

nodes.name: Image Failed
nodes.notes: The attachment could not be read. Recorded and processing continues.

nodes.name: Unsupported Result
nodes.notes: Unsupported format or skipped image. Recorded, not analysed.

nodes.name: Merge Attachment Results
nodes.notes: Collects every attachment result of the current email. Single input: works with any mix of attachment types.

nodes.name: Aggregate Attachments
nodes.notes: One item per email with attachments[].

nodes.name: Build LLM Input
nodes.notes: Prompt + strict JSON schema + image parts. Truncates body and attachment text to the configured limits.

nodes.name: Analyze Email
nodes.notes: OpenRouter chat completion with response_format json_schema (strict). Interprets only; it does not control the flow.

nodes.name: Validate LLM Output
nodes.notes: Parses and validates the model JSON. Unusable output becomes processing_status llm_failed.

nodes.name: Build Failure Record
nodes.notes: The LLM call failed after retries. The email metadata is still recorded and the user is notified.

nodes.name: Build Sheet Row
nodes.notes: Flattens the result into exactly the sheet columns (used for both success and failure).

nodes.name: Save to Google Sheets
nodes.notes: Append or update keyed on message_id: one row per email, idempotent. RAW keeps ids and dates as text.

nodes.name: Record Result
nodes.notes: Row saved (success or llm_failed). Back to the loop.

nodes.name: Record Save Failure
nodes.notes: Row not saved after retries. Nothing is lost in Gmail: run the import again later.

nodes.name: Build Summary
nodes.notes: Single result item: status, total_found, processed, skipped_existing, failed, query_used, errors. This is what the caller receives.
